title: Identical composition ladders can hide wrong ordered products
statement: Swapping the tails of P07 and P08 after residue nine produces wrong-order chains while preserving the pooled multiset of parent compositions and every prefix- and suffix-fragment composition. Replacing two equal-abundance library members therefore conceals 12.5% wrong sequences in that ideal readout. This concerns pooled composition ladders; calibrated chromatography, ion mobility, fragment intensities or additional fragmentation might distinguish them.
